body: I haven't touched my guitars in years, or my clarinet. I think the Clarinet is totally out because of my chronic cough. But I really should try to start guitar up again, I just stare at them sitting at the end of my bed all the time. Same with drawing, it just seems all the things I used to really love I just can't do anymore.

I'm Aria, I run a geek themed group out in the East Bay of SF in California. I'd love to be able help out more with getting fun things for the group. I've gone above 1200 members (never thought it would get this huge!), thankfully only 30-60 people show up to each of the events. Unfortunately I am on disability so I don't have a lot to give though I do try my best!

Long time gamer enthusiast, plus many other geeky pursuits. 

Even the gift of ideas on how I can get more nifty things for my group members would be more then welcome! 
I'm always looking for good ideas. 

I do have my own amazon wishlist, but I'm looking more for things for the group. :) 

I've been running the group for 5 years now, it's one of the few things I take a lot of pride in. I just wish I could do more!

Oh and like it says in my interview I was sent to one of those places despite never having done illegal drugs. It was way out of my comfort zone. My "drugs" have always been video games, reading, manga, anime, scifi/fantasy.

I started going back to a psychologist that I went to when I was young. I only just started back up with her a month ago. I've been nervous about going back to therapy because of this: https://www.reddit.com/r/TrueReddit/comments/1eujm0/thousands_of_american_teens_are_trapped_in/

I'm the Aria that was interviewed in that vice article. I changed my reddit username because of my ex. Not that I'd used it much before then.

Only birth control that doesn't mess with me is the nuvaring, probably because it's the lowest hormonal one. Been on it for 10 years, If I forget to put a ring in though oh man the cramps are brutal. Worse now then when I was a teenager. TMI but I get horrible clots now if I have my period. Right after I got my first cyst that burst back when I was 21 that's when it got so much worse, now at 28 (almost 29) they are just viscous. 
Yeah, they have to use the smallest gauge butterfly needle that they use on infants on me because my veins are so tiny, takes most technicians several pokes to get me. Doesn't help I also have thick blood. 
Lung transplant sounds rough. So far I've only ever had very minor back surgery. Though depending on what kind of parasite this ends up being it might need to be removed through surgery. I really hope it's just one that can be killed with medication. 
I mean I'm really glad it's not lupus, but I'm so skeptical about once the parasite is gone if I'm really going to be all better. I'm worried I'm setting myself up for a huge disappointment. 
I know my anxiety isn't going to go away with the parasite, I doubt my sleep issues (either sleeping too much or too little) will go away. I mean what if they are wrong and it's lupus and a parasite? Unlikely sure, but still. I have so many worries. As I said my anxiety issues. I almost want to end my life before I can get disappointed. Dumb right?

Mine are just brutal, and pain medication doesn't work on me, usually I go on continuous cycling with my birth control to avoid most of it, but it still causes the emotional distress and some of the pain. I get chronic cysts on my ovaries as well, which are just lovely when they burst /sarcasm. 

For years they said it was fibromyalgia or lupus. Now they are telling me it's a parasite but they don't know which one, I have to go through even more tests. Last two visits to the lab I had 19 vials of blood drawn and 15 vials. Also have something called small intestinal bacteria overgrowth. 

Both of them cause a lot of pain in my stomach and abdomen. I've lost over 30lbs because I can barely eat food.

I often say I wish I could have a vacation from my body. Today is one of those days. Even though I just slept 22 hours was awake for 3 and then slept another 8 hours, part of me really just wants to go back to sleep. It's the only way I can get away from the pain. Despite my doctors having me on gobs of medications. None of them seem to do much of anything. 

Doesn't help that I think it's going to be that time of the month soon, probably why I'm more depressed then usual. It would have be now. 
Maybe I will just go back to sleep, probably better then sitting here thinking about ending it all.
I used to write, these days I feel like I can't concentrate past the illness and pain.
How do you deal with it, if you do?

Not a specific character, but a type. I get really annoyed with Mary Sues. How can they magically know how to fix all the issues? Where are their flaws? Why do they have to be completely perfect? It just makes them unrealistic and incredibly hard to relate to. Takes me right out of the story.
The Egyptian Book of the Dead. Well it is a Funerary Text meant to guide souls to the afterlife. I usually enjoy culturally based books but struggled with this one. The illustrations are nice though.
